entry.title: Ten faithful `__restrict` libc prototypes are now readable but undeclared; `regexec` and most `getpeername` units keep other reader shapes
entry.why: Card W43-LIBC-RESULT-ALIAS repaired the declared-ABI reader (W43-LIBC-POINTER-QUALIFIER-READER) and measured the fourteen prototypes card W43-LIBC-CONTRACTS withdrew, through the same census tool over the 185 captured units (docs/reports/w43-libc-result-alias/abi-evidence.json): printf, fprintf, snprintf and sprintf now agree in all 168 units that declare them; stat (109), strftime (144), gettimeofday (107), getsockopt (105), dlsym (4), cnd_timedwait (83), pthread_sigmask (5) and regerror (1) agree everywhere they are declared; getpeername agrees in 12 units and is still withdrawn in 93, where `_GNU_SOURCE` spells its address as the `__SOCKADDR_ARG` transparent union (W43-LIBC-ABI-READER-SHAPES' bind/connect shape); regexec is still withdrawn in its 1 unit because `regmatch_t __pmatch[__restrict_arr]` puts the qualifier inside an array bound, which the reader refuses. This card declared none of them: the printf family is LIBC-PRINTF-FAMILY's leaf-directed card, and the other ten were outside its brief. Discharge condition: a declarative card lands the ten non-printf prototypes (or refuses them by name) with its own leaf-by-leaf attribution, and the array-bound qualifier is either read (C11 6.7.6.3p7 adjusts `T a[restrict]` to `T *restrict a`) with Lean parity or refused on record.

ground: Its discharge condition: a declarative card lands the ten non-printf prototypes (or refuses them by name) with its own leaf-by-leaf attribution, and the array-bound qualifier is either read (C11 6.7.6.3p7) with Lean parity or refused on record. Card W43-LIBC-RESTRICT-PROTOTYPES declared all ten as the neutral element in providers/quirin-provider-libc: stat (sys_stat), strftime and gettimeofday (time), getsockopt and getpeername (socket), dlsym (dlfcn), cnd_timedwait and pthread_sigmask (threads), and regexec and regerror in the new libc/regex.qcore. It read the array-bound qualifier: legacy_declared_abi.rs `array_bound_is_read` accepts a bound of qualifiers and at most one size word, so glibc regexec's `regmatch_t __pmatch[__restrict __nmatch]` agrees in its one unit, with Rust table rows in crates/qcore-c-gateway/tests/loader_abi.rs and 13 audited theorems added to QCore.PointerQualifierReader; the reader change alone reproduced all five BEFORE artifacts byte for byte and moved none of the 10,686 census rows of the 130 selected declarations. The declarations removed 36 leaves and added 2, all attributed, and moved 3 functions Unknown -> Safe (mk_plugin_load_symbol, mk_signal_thread_sigpipe_safe, rd_regex_exec). getpeername stays withdrawn in the 93 `_GNU_SOURCE` units, its only pinned call site included, and is registered as W43-LIBC-GETPEERNAME-SOCKADDR-UNION; dlsym's handle lifetime is registered as W43-LIBC-DLSYM-HANDLE-LIFETIME. docs/reports/w43-libc-restrict-prototypes/README.md.
